name: gifmate
description: MCP server that lets coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor...) watch animated GIFs frame by frame and send GIFs back from GIPHY.

scripts.build: esbuild src/server.mjs src/anim-worker.mjs --bundle --minify --platform=node --format=esm --target=node18 --outdir=dist --out-extension:.js=.mjs --banner:js="import { createRequire as __cr } from 'module'; const require = __cr(import.meta.url);"
